parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Docker image from which to create the container. If image tag is omitted, "latest" will be used. (templated)

parameters.name: api_version
parameters.description: Remote API version. Set to ``auto`` to automatically detect the server's version.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Command to be run in the container. (templated)

parameters.name: container_name
parameters.description: Name of the container. Optional (templated)

parameters.name: cpus
parameters.description: Number of CPUs to assign to the container. This value gets multiplied with 1024. See https://docs.docker.com/engine/reference/run/#cpu-share-constraint

parameters.name: docker_url
parameters.description: URL or list of URLs of the host(s) running the docker daemon. Default is the value of the ``DOCKER_HOST`` environment variable or unix://var/run/docker.sock if it is unset.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Environment variables to set in the container. (templated)

parameters.name: private_environment
parameters.description: Private environment variables to set in the container. These are not templated, and hidden from the website.

parameters.name: env_file
parameters.description: Relative path to the ``.env`` file with environment variables to set in the container. Overridden by variables in the environment parameter. (templated)

parameters.name: force_pull
parameters.description: Pull the docker image on every run. Default is False.

parameters.name: mem_limit
parameters.description: Maximum amount of memory the container can use. Either a float value, which represents the limit in bytes, or a string like ``128m`` or ``1g``.

parameters.name: host_tmp_dir
parameters.description: Specify the location of the temporary directory on the host which will be mapped to tmp_dir. If not provided defaults to using the standard system temp directory.

parameters.name: network_mode
parameters.description: Network mode for the container. It can be one of the following: - ``"bridge"``: Create new network stack for the container with default docker bridge network - ``"none"``: No networking for this container - ``"container:<name|id>"``: Use the network stack of another container specified via <name|id> - ``"host"``: Use the host network stack. Incompatible with `port_bindings` - ``"<network-name>|<network-id>"``: Connects the container to user created network (using ``docker network create`` command)

parameters.name: tls_ca_cert
parameters.description: Path to a PEM-encoded certificate authority to secure the docker connection.

parameters.name: tls_client_cert
parameters.description: Path to the PEM-encoded certificate used to authenticate docker client.

parameters.name: tls_client_key
parameters.description: Path to the PEM-encoded key used to authenticate docker client.

parameters.name: tls_verify
parameters.description: Set ``True`` to verify the validity of the provided certificate.

parameters.name: tls_hostname
parameters.description: Hostname to match against the docker server certificate or False to disable the check.

parameters.name: tls_ssl_version
parameters.description: Version of SSL to use when communicating with docker daemon.

parameters.name: mount_tmp_dir
parameters.description: Specify whether the temporary directory should be bind-mounted from the host to the container. Defaults to True

parameters.name: tmp_dir
parameters.description: Mount point inside the container to a temporary directory created on the host by the operator. The path is also made available via the environment variable ``AIRFLOW_TMP_DIR`` inside the container.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Default user inside the docker container.

parameters.name: mounts
parameters.description: List of volumes to mount into the container. Each item should be a :py:class:`docker.types.Mount` instance. (templated)

parameters.name: entrypoint
parameters.description: Overwrite the default ENTRYPOINT of the image

parameters.name: working_dir
parameters.description: Working directory to set on the container (equivalent to the -w switch the docker client)

parameters.name: xcom_all
parameters.description: Push all the stdout or just the last line. The default is False (last line).

parameters.name: docker_conn_id
parameters.description: The :ref:`Docker connection id <howto/connection:docker>`

parameters.name: dns
parameters.description: Docker custom DNS servers

parameters.name: dns_search
parameters.description: Docker custom DNS search domain

parameters.name: auto_remove
parameters.description: Enable removal of the container when the container's process exits. Possible values: - ``never``: (default) do not remove container - ``success``: remove on success - ``force``: always remove container

parameters.name: shm_size
parameters.description: Size of ``/dev/shm`` in bytes. The size must be greater than 0. If omitted uses system default.

parameters.name: tty
parameters.description: Allocate pseudo-TTY to the container This needs to be set see logs of the Docker container.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Optional hostname for the container.

parameters.name: privileged
parameters.description: Give extended privileges to this container.

parameters.name: cap_add
parameters.description: Include container capabilities

parameters.name: extra_hosts
parameters.description: Additional hostnames to resolve inside the container, as a mapping of hostname to IP address.

parameters.name: retrieve_output
parameters.description: Should this docker image consistently attempt to pull from and output file before manually shutting down the image. Useful for cases where users want a pickle serialized output that is not posted to logs

parameters.name: retrieve_output_path
parameters.description: path for output file that will be retrieved and passed to xcom

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout for API calls, in seconds. Default is 60 seconds.

parameters.name: device_requests
parameters.description: Expose host resources such as GPUs to the container.

parameters.name: log_opts_max_size
parameters.description: The maximum size of the log before it is rolled. A positive integer plus a modifier representing the unit of measure (k, m, or g). Eg: 10m or 1g Defaults to -1 (unlimited).

parameters.name: log_opts_max_file
parameters.description: The maximum number of log files that can be present. If rolling the logs creates excess files, the oldest file is removed. Only effective when max-size is also set. A positive integer. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: ipc_mode
parameters.description: Set the IPC mode for the container.

parameters.name: skip_on_exit_code
parameters.description: If task exits with this exit code, leave the task in ``skipped`` state (default: None). If set to ``None``, any non-zero exit code will be treated as a failure.

parameters.name: port_bindings
parameters.description: Publish a container's port(s) to the host. It is a dictionary of value where the key indicates the port to open inside the container and value indicates the host port that binds to the container port. Incompatible with ``"host"`` in ``network_mode``.

parameters.name: ulimits
parameters.description: List of ulimit options to set for the container. Each item should be a :py:class:`docker.types.Ulimit` instance.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: A dictionary of name-value labels (e.g. ``{"label1": "value1", "label2": "value2"}``) or a list of names of labels to set with empty values (e.g. ``["label1", "label2"]``)

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Arguments to the command.

parameters.name: enable_logging
parameters.description: Show the application's logs in operator's logs. Supported only if the Docker engine is using json-file or journald logging drivers. The `tty` parameter should be set to use this with Python applications.

parameters.name: configs
parameters.description: List of docker configs to be exposed to the containers of the swarm service. The configs are ConfigReference objects as per the docker api [https://docker-py.readthedocs.io/en/stable/services.html#docker.models.services.ServiceCollection.create]_

parameters.name: secrets
parameters.description: List of docker secrets to be exposed to the containers of the swarm service. The secrets are SecretReference objects as per the docker create_service api. [https://docker-py.readthedocs.io/en/stable/services.html#docker.models.services.ServiceCollection.create]_

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Indicate whether a service should be deployed as a replicated or global service, and associated parameters

parameters.name: networks
parameters.description: List of network names or IDs or NetworkAttachmentConfig to attach the service to.

parameters.name: placement
parameters.description: Placement instructions for the scheduler. If a list is passed instead, it is assumed to be a list of constraints as part of a Placement object.

parameters.name: container_resources
parameters.description: Resources for the launched container. The resources are Resources as per the docker api [https://docker-py.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api.html#docker.types.Resources]_ This parameter has precedence on the mem_limit parameter.

parameters.name: service_prefix
parameters.description: Prefix for the service name. The service name will be generated as ``{service_prefix}-{random_string}``. Default is 'airflow'.

parameters.name: logging_driver
parameters.description: The logging driver to use for container logs. Docker by default uses 'json-file'. For more information on Docker logging drivers: https://docs.docker.com/engine/logging/configure/ NOTE: Only drivers 'json-file' and 'gelf' are currently supported. If left empty, 'json-file' will be used.

parameters.name: logging_driver_opts
parameters.description: Dictionary of logging options to use with the associated logging driver chosen. Depending on the logging driver, some options are required. Failure to include them, will result in the operator failing. All option values must be strings and wrapped in double quotes. For information on 'json-file' options: https://docs.docker.com/engine/logging/drivers/json-file/ For information on 'gelf' options: https://docs.docker.com/engine/logging/drivers/gelf/ NOTE: 'gelf' driver requires the 'gelf-address' option to be set.

parameters.name: docker_conn_id
parameters.description: :ref:`Docker connection id <howto/connection:docker>` where stored credentials to Docker Registry. If set to ``None`` or empty then hook does not login to Container Registry.

parameters.name: base_url
parameters.description: URL or list of URLs to the Docker server.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version of the API to use. Use ``auto`` or ``None`` for automatically detect the server's version.

parameters.name: tls
parameters.description: Is connection required TLS, for enable pass ``True`` for use with default options, or pass a `docker.tls.TLSConfig` object to use custom configurations.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Default timeout for API calls, in seconds.

parameters.name: python_callable
parameters.description: Function to decorate

parameters.name: multiple_outputs
parameters.description: If set, function return value will be unrolled to multiple XCom values. Dict will unroll to XCom values with keys as XCom keys. Defaults to False.
